name: Tencent releases Hy4 Flash productivity model
title: Tencent releases Hy4 Flash productivity model
summary: Tencent released Hy4 Flash, a natively multimodal model with 224B total parameters and 12B active, a 1M-token context, and API pricing of $0.003 cached, $0.07 input, and $0.281 output per million tokens. The lab says human blind tests match Claude Haiku 5.5 on everyday work at an 18x lower task cost, and the model is now on OpenRouter at a limited-time 50 percent discount.
